dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.topProfitEmpty: Profit shows once market prices are known. Fetch them with the price refresh button in the top bar or enter a price by hand in the set detail.
dashboard.moversEmpty: Comparison needs at least two prices over time. Check back in a few days.
dashboard.emptyHint: Add your first set and the numbers will appear.
dashboard.priceMissingPlural: We do not know the market price for {count} piece yet. | We do not know the market price for {count} pieces yet.
dashboard.chartHint: Drag to pan, Ctrl + wheel to zoom

collection.title: Collection
collection.search: Search by name, number or location…
collection.emptyHint: Try changing the filters or add a new set.
collection.figuresElsewherePlural: {count} series minifigure is in Minifigures | {count} series minifigures are in Minifigures
collection.approxPriceHint: Derived from the new-condition price, the source has none for this condition yet.

add.categoriesHint: Categories whose rule matches the set are preselected. Applies to the whole set, not just this piece.
add.categoriesHintSeries: Categories whose rule matches are preselected. The category carries over to every figure in the series.
add.title: Add a set
add.hint: Enter the number from the box, for example 10294 or 10294-1. Details are pulled from the catalogue.
add.notFound: The set was not found in the catalogue
add.locationHint: Suggests from places you already used
add.seriesHint: This is a series of {count} minifigures. Pick the ones you have.
add.sealedBagHint: I do not know which figure is inside. I will identify it after opening.
add.hintAny: The number from the box (10294) or the 13 digits under the bars. Use the icon on the right to scan with the camera.
add.noCatalogTitle: Without a Rebrickable key the app cannot look up sets
add.noCatalogText: Save the set by the number on the box, the name is optional. No photo, series or part count will be filled in. A Rebrickable key is free, we recommend connecting it.

detail.rrpLine: The yellow dashed line is the retail price {price}.
detail.noPriceRefreshHint: Fetch the price for this set only, the rest of the collection is left alone.
detail.refreshNoteNone: The source returned no price · calls left today: {left}
detail.forecastTitle: Forecast for a new, sealed set (BrickEconomy)
detail.noPriceHint: Press refresh in the top bar or enter a price manually.
detail.popularity: Owned by {owned} and wanted by {wanted} people on Brickset

sell.title: Sell a piece
sell.costsHint: Deducted from the profit so it is net.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.emptyHint: Add a set you want and keep an eye on its price.
wishlist.targetHint: You get a notice when the market price drops to this amount or below. Empty = no target.

settings.title: Settings
settings.shareIntro: Anyone with the link sees your collection without signing in and cannot change anything. You can revoke it at any time.
settings.shareValuesOn: On, only send this link to someone you trust.
settings.shareValuesOff: Off, visitors see only the sets and photos.
settings.shareNote: When amounts are off, prices never leave the server. They cannot be found in the page source either. The link is not published anywhere, but anyone holding it can open the page, so send it only to people you trust.
settings.providerHint: These keys are yours and apply to this account only. They are stored encrypted and cannot be read back, only their last characters are shown.
settings.keyRebrickable: Names, years, parts, photos and series members. Free.
settings.keyBrickEconomy: Market values and their history. Part of Premium membership, 100 calls a day.
settings.keyBrickset: Optional. Adds the retail price and minifigure count.
settings.keyKeep: Fill in only to change it
settings.noPriceKey: Without a BrickEconomy key, prices are entered by hand.
settings.quotaSpent: The daily quota is spent, it resets tomorrow.
settings.exportHint: Downloads every piece as CSV, ready for a spreadsheet.
settings.registrationOpenHint: Anyone with the app address can create an account. Close registration once everyone has theirs.
settings.registrationClosedHint: New accounts cannot be created; the login page hides “New account”. Existing accounts keep working.
settings.registrationFirstHint: Takes effect immediately, no restart. The .env value is only the default for a fresh install.
settings.shareKindWishlistHint: What I would like, e.g. for family
settings.operatorHint: The name and contact appear in the privacy policy. They are required when registration is open to strangers.

public.valuesHidden: The owner chose not to publish prices.
public.notFound: The link does not exist or was revoked
public.notFoundHint: Ask the collection owner for a new link.
public.wishlistEmpty: The list is empty for now

piece.title: Edit piece
piece.removeWarning: The piece and its history will be gone. If you sold it, use Sell instead.
piece.categoriesHint: Categories belong to the set, not the piece: a change applies to all its pieces. Saved with the piece.

prices.refreshHint: Refresh market prices · {count} calls left today
prices.noKey: Add a BrickEconomy key in Settings first
prices.providerOff: No BrickEconomy key, prices are entered manually
prices.manualHint: Saved as today's market price and shown in the chart.

insights.cagrTooShort: annual return after one year of holding
insights.forecastNote: For {sample} of {sealed} sealed pieces BrickEconomy has a forecast for. Built pieces are not covered.
insights.forecastEmpty: The forecast appears after refreshing prices of sealed sets.
insights.subthemeHint: Subseries fill in as prices of individual sets are refreshed.

photos.title: Piece photos
photos.empty: No photos yet. Photograph the box, the condition and any flaws, useful for insurance and for selling.
photos.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded.
photos.hint: The photo is shrunk to at most 1 MB and its GPS location is removed.

listing.title: Listing
listing.priceNew: based on the market price of a sealed set
listing.priceUsed: based on the market price of an opened set
listing.priceApprox: derived from the other condition, double-check it
listing.noPrice: Market price unknown, fill in the price yourself.

inventory.title: Collection inventory
inventory.subtitle: As of {date}
inventory.note: Market values per BrickEconomy as of the last price refresh. Pieces without a known price show a dash and are not counted.

filters.title: Filters
filters.viewFigures: View “{name}” filters series figures. The collection shows sets only; the figures are in Minifigures.
filters.viewFiguresHint: The collection ignores the series-figure filter; the figures are in Minifigures. The view still works as the Overview scope.
filters.viewNameHint: For example “Sealed F1” or “For sale from the attic”.
filters.noCategories: None yet. A category collects sets across series, for example all F1.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.rulesHint: A set belongs to the category when at least one rule matches. You can add or exclude a set by hand in its detail.
categories.noRules: No rules: sets are added by hand in the set detail.
categories.removeHint: Your sets stay, only the category and its manual choices go.

minifigs.title: Minifigures
minifigs.needsKey: The list of all collectible series comes from Rebrickable. Add your key in Settings; it is free and does not use the price quota.
minifigs.emptyHint: Once a Rebrickable key is set, the list downloads by itself.
minifigs.seriesPiecesHint: Every piece of the series, including sealed bags and sold figures, and the series price refresh
minifigs.syncPartial: Some series failed to download ({failed}); it will retry.
minifigs.syncSwitchedOff: Downloading all series is switched off in Settings → Data. Series the app already knows are shown.

purchase.title: I bought it
purchase.hint: Flags, notes and photos can be added in the detail.
purchase.hintWishlist: It leaves the wishlist once saved. The rest can be added in the detail.
purchase.includeOwned: Also add the ones I already own (duplicates)
purchase.willAddPlural: {count} figure will be added | {count} figures will be added
purchase.splitHint: The total is split evenly to the cent, so it adds up to what you paid.

scan.title: Point the camera at the barcode
scan.hint: Hold the code level on the red line, about 10–15 cm from the camera. If nothing happens, press “Take a photo”.
scan.insecure: Live camera view only works on a secure address (https or localhost). Use “Take a photo” or type the code.
scan.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in the browser next to the address, or type the code.
scan.noCamera: No camera found. Type the code instead; it is under the bars.
scan.failed: The camera could not be started. Type the code instead; it is under the bars.
scan.invalid: This is not a valid barcode.
scan.notFound: We do not know this code yet. Enter the set number from the box and the code will be remembered.
scan.noSetNumber: The code belongs to “{title}”, but no set number could be read from it. Enter it from the box and the code will be remembered.
scan.limit: Free barcode lookups are used up for today. Enter the set number from the box and the code will be remembered.
scan.photoNoCode: No barcode in the shot. Move it closer, keep the bars level and try again.
scan.photoFailed: The photo could not be read. Try another one or type the code.
scan.willRemember: Code {code} will be linked to this set when saved
scan.wedgeReady: Hand scanner: just scan, even from another screen
scan.disabled: Barcode lookup is switched off in Settings → Data. Enter the number from the box.
scan.wedgeHint: The same code again adds another piece. A different code saves this set as the form shows it and loads the next one.
scan.cached: We looked this code up on {date} and found nothing, so it was not searched again.
scan.closeDialogFirst: Close the open window first, then scan

themes.title: Series
themes.emptyHint: Series appear once the collection has sets. Find any other series above and save it with the star.
themes.needsKey: Series and their sets come from Brickset. Add your key in Settings.
themes.refreshHint: Downloads this year’s sets from Brickset again (one call)

usage.title: API limits and calls
usage.notCounted: Does not count toward the daily limit
usage.note: Days in UTC, as the services count them. * = not counted toward the limit. Click a service to filter the history. Entries are kept for 30 days.

inflation.hintOff: In today's money: adjusts purchase prices for Slovak inflation (Eurostat) to show the real profit.
inflation.hintOn: Purchase and sale prices are adjusted for Slovak inflation up to {month}. Market value is today’s. Click to turn off.
inflation.failed: The inflation index could not be loaded, amounts are nominal. It will retry in an hour.

totals.realHint: Purchase prices adjusted for Slovak inflation up to {month} (Eurostat). What you bought would cost {amount} today. The difference to today's value is the profit inflation did not eat.

imports.title: Import from a file
imports.intro: Add many sets at once from Excel or CSV. You get a preview first; nothing is saved until you confirm.
imports.step2Hint: Only the set number is required. Quantity, condition, price, date, location and more are optional. Instructions are on the second sheet.
imports.step3Hint: You will see what gets added, what you already have and what cannot be read.
imports.drop: Drop a file here or click to choose one
imports.tipExport: The collection export works too: edit it in Excel and upload it back. Unchanged rows are recognised and skipped.
imports.lookingUp: Looking up sets the app does not know yet: {done} of {total}
imports.lookingUpHint: Rebrickable allows one request per second. You can leave, the preview will wait here.
imports.ignored: These columns are not known and will be skipped: {columns}
imports.duplicateHint: Rows “already owned” are skipped. If it really is another piece, tick it.
imports.skipped: Rows with errors ({count}) will be skipped. Fix them in the file and upload again, or add them by hand.
imports.doneHint: New sets have no market price yet. The price refresh button in the top bar fills them in, step by step within the daily quota.
imports.undoneInfo: The import was undone. Its pieces and wishlist items are deleted.
imports.undoText: This deletes {pieces} pieces and {wishes} wishlist items the import added, even if you edited them since, including photos. Wishlist items the import removed come back. Things you added by hand stay.

sources.intro: Each service is a card. A switch is one kind of call; below it is what that call brings. A switched-off call is not sent and uses no quota.
sources.reserveHint: Background work stops when this many calls remain; the rest is kept for adding and scanning.
sources.batchHint: With a large collection prices refresh step by step: sets with no known price first (most recently added first), then the ones refreshed longest ago.

rebrickable.name: Rebrickable
rebrickable.about: Set and minifigure catalog. Free, no daily limit (about one call per second).
unlocks: Set lookup by number: name, year, series, pieces, photo
Collectible minifigure series and the Minifigures section
Looking up unknown sets on import

brickset.name: Brickset
brickset.about: Barcodes, retail prices and descriptions. Free for private use, 100 getSets calls a day.
unlocks: Retail price (RRP) and average purchase discount

brickeconomy.name: BrickEconomy
brickeconomy.about: Market prices. Paid Premium membership, 100 calls a day (the app caps at 90).
unlocks: Market price of new and used pieces
Price history and chart in set detail
Collection value, profit and annual return without manual prices
Price movers and value forecast for 2 and 5 years

upcitemdb.name: UPCitemdb
upcitemdb.about: Free barcode database without a key, backup for Brickset. About 100 lookups a day for the whole server.
unlocks: Looking up codes Brickset does not know

eurostat.name: Eurostat
eurostat.about: Slovak consumer price index. No key, no limit, fetched once a week.
unlocks: Real profit after inflation in the collection

sources.autoPurchase: Fill in the purchase price from the retail price
sources.autoPurchaseHint: A piece without a purchase price gets the retail price at the next price refresh (from BrickEconomy, otherwise Brickset). It costs no calls. An icon marks such a price; editing the price by hand removes the mark. Older pieces get it at their next refresh too.
sources.ownDataOnly: You see data from this service only for sets your own key asked for. Other accounts do not see it and public links never show it.
sources.personalLicense: The BrickEconomy licence is personal: the same key in two accounts means sharing it.

set.title: Set basics
set.hint: On adding, import and scanning. Without it no set is created, so it cannot be switched off.

series_sync.title: All minifigure series
series_sync.hint: The Minifigures section checks for new series once a week (dozens of calls, no limit). Off: only series you own something from are shown.

on_add.title: When adding a set
on_add.hint: 1 call per new set. Off: the set is created from Rebrickable only and the details are filled in later.
on_add.brings: RRP in euros, barcode, retirement, description, tags, rating and popularity

backfill.title: Filling in older sets
backfill.hint: At most 40 sets when the collection opens, each once. Keeps the reserve.
backfill.brings: RRP in euros, barcode, retirement, description, tags, rating and popularity

on_detail.title: When opening set detail
on_detail.hint: 1 call if the set has no Brickset data yet.
on_detail.brings: RRP in euros, barcode, retirement, description, tags, rating and popularity

barcode.title: Barcode lookup
barcode.hint: 1 call per unknown code; a found code is saved and the next scan is free.

waves.title: Series sets by year
waves.hint: 1 call per series year on first open; this and last year every 30 days.

themes.title: Series and year list
themes.hint: Does not count to the limit. Off: the Series section is hidden.

images.title: More set photos
images.hint: Not counted in the limit. The gallery is fetched once when you open a set; a set added before this feature asks Brickset for its ID once (1 call). Off: the detail shows only the main photo.
images.brings: official photos from all sides, the box, details

prices.title: Refresh prices of the whole collection
prices.hint: Top bar button, 1 call per set, keeps the reserve. Off: the button is hidden.
prices.brings: new and used price, price history, 2 and 5 year forecast, RRP, barcode

price_detail.title: Refresh one set price
price_detail.hint: Button in set detail, 1 call, may use the whole limit.

barcode.title: Barcode backup
barcode.hint: When Brickset does not know the code. The limit is shared by the whole server.

inflation.title: Inflation index
inflation.hint: Once a week. Off: the In today's money switch adjusts nothing.

notice.undone: Undone, pieces removed from the collection
notice.undoneWish: Undone, pieces removed from the collection and the wishlist is as it was
notice.undoneStillOwned: Undone, pieces removed from the collection. Still in your collection, so not back in the wishlist: {what}
notice.seriesNotSaved: Series {name} was not saved, no minifigure selected
notice.sellFailed: The sale could not be recorded
notice.wishFailed: The wishlist could not be changed
notice.followupFailed: Saved, but the category or barcode could not be stored
notice.categoriesFailed: The set's categories could not be saved

formMemory.title: What adding remembers
formMemory.intro: A switched-on field is prefilled with what you entered last time. A switched-off field stays empty (today's date, new sealed).
formMemory.where: Applies to Add set, I bought it, I have them all and the automatic save after a scan.

purchaseAuto.title: Purchase price filled in from the retail price
purchaseAuto.cardHint: Purchase price filled in from the retail price for {count} pcs
purchaseAuto.dialogHint: Filled in from the retail price. Change it and it becomes your own.

bulk.locationHint: An empty field clears the location.
bulk.categoryNote: The category goes on the set, it affects {sets}.

scope.label: Scope
scope.note: Dashboard numbers cover this scope only; the menu shows the whole collection.
scope.removed: Scope “{label}” no longer exists, the dashboard shows the whole collection

share.allHint: The link shows everything, including sets you add later.
share.chosenHint: The link shows only the checked sets; a whole series for a series.

check.title: Check price
check.warningTitle: Every check uses a BrickEconomy call
check.warningText: After you type or scan a set, its price is fetched from BrickEconomy right away and uses one call of the daily quota of 100. A set checked in the last {hours} hours comes from stored prices and costs nothing.
check.disconnectedText: Without it the app cannot show the current price, only one it has already stored. Connect a BrickEconomy Premium key in Settings → Data.
check.inputHint: Type a number (e.g. 75192) or scan the barcode on the box
check.notFound: Neither the app nor the connected services know set {num}. Check the number on the box.
check.eanUnknown: Barcode {code} is unknown. Try the set number from the box.
check.noPriceFound: BrickEconomy has no price for this set
check.priceFailed: The price could not be fetched
check.fetched: Price just fetched from BrickEconomy, {left} calls left today
check.cached: Price from the last 24 hours, no call used
check.pickMember: A series has no price itself. Pick a figure:
check.recentEmpty: Nothing yet. Checked sets will show up here.
check.identifyRebrickable: Unknown sets are looked up on Rebrickable (with a photo).
check.identifyBrickEconomy: Rebrickable is not connected: an unknown set is recognised from the BrickEconomy price response (name, series, year, no photo), in the same call.
check.identifyNothing: Without Rebrickable and BrickEconomy only sets the app already knows can be checked, with stored prices only.
check.noSources: The app does not know set {num} yet and no connected service can look it up. Connect Rebrickable or BrickEconomy.
check.priceDisconnected: Without BrickEconomy the current price is unknown, showing the stored one
check.quota: Today’s 100 BrickEconomy calls are used up, try tomorrow
check.blocked: Manual price fetching is turned off in Settings → Data
check.unsupported: A bare minifigure is not priced here, see the detail page

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.noOperator: The administrator of this instance has not filled in their name and contact yet (Settings → Application).
privacy.cookiesIntro: The app uses only one strictly necessary sign-in cookie and remembers settings you choose in the browser. Under § 109(8) of Act No. 452/2021 no consent is needed for that. The sign-in cookie ends when you close the browser; it stays for 30 days only if you tick Remember me yourself when signing in. It uses no analytics, advertising or tracking.
privacy.cookieNote: We use only a strictly necessary sign-in cookie, no analytics or ads. Details are in the privacy policy.

storage.name: Name
storage.refreshLasts: until you close the browser; 30 days if you tick Remember me

account.title: My data
account.intro: You can download everything the app has about you and delete the account with all data and photos.
account.exportFailed: The data could not be downloaded
account.deleteWarning: The account, the whole collection, wishlist, photos, links and settings will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteExportFirst: Do you want to download them first?
account.deleteFailed: The account could not be deleted

keyHint.priceDetail: BrickEconomy (Premium key) adds the market price of new and used pieces, the history and the value forecast.
keyHint.bricksetDetail: Brickset (free key) adds the description, tags, rating, retail price and more photos of the set.
keyHint.rebrickableDetail: Rebrickable (free key) adds the name, photo, series and parts.
keyHint.wishlist: BrickEconomy (Premium key) adds the current price and a notice when a set drops to your target price.
keyHint.barcode: Brickset (free key) recognises barcodes, UPCitemdb is the fallback (just switch it on).

unlock.title: What else the app can do
unlock.intro: These appear once you connect a key to the service (or switch it on). You only see data from a service with your own key.
